criterion: At least seven complete default production trials, median and maximum upper count at most 3.2B.

baseline.scope: Exclusive browser resource-coalition creation through encoded document PNG availability, including browser/window startup and the navigation/capture workflow described by navigation_scope. Brave includes CDP target/window setup. OS filesystem and shader caches are not cleared. This is a full startup/capture workflow, not isolated page navigation or rendering work.
